Question 20
?

The volume of water V in a pool being filled increases at a rate that's inversely proportional to the square of the volume of water in the pool at that moment. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the volume of water V in the pool?

a
dVdt=kt2,k>0
b
dVdt=kV2,k>0
c
dVdt=−kV2,k>0
d
dVdt=−kV2,k>0
e
dVdt=kV2,k>0
